htn_kidney.title: Hemostatic imbalances in chronic kidney disease: A regional perspective from Bihar.
htn_kidney.journal: Journal of family medicine and primary care
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：评估CKD患者各阶段的血小板指数和基本凝血参数，探讨患者凝血参数与CKD分期的相关性。 临床提示：这是一项在三级医院血液科进行的为期 2 年的前瞻性观察研究。
htn_kidney.abstract: To evaluate platelet indices and basic blood coagulation parameters in various stages of CKD patients and to find out any correlation between patients' coagulation parameters and CKD staging. It was a 2-year prospective observational study conducted in the Department of Hematology in a tertiary care hospital. Sample size was 160, out of which 80 were cases and 80 were age and gender matched controls. Patients of both sexes and age group ranging ≥20 years belonging to various stages of non-dialyzed CKD were included in the study. portal_hypertension.title: Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Non-cirrhotic Portal Fibrosis/Idiopathic Portal Hypertension: An Under-recognized Complication-A Case Report and Literature Review.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of clinical and experimental hepatology
portal_hypertension.authors: Singh A, Harindranath S, Kaur P
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：血管性肝病被认为是非肝硬化肝脏中发生肝细胞癌（HCC）的危险因素。 临床提示：虽然这种关联在布加综合征等疾病中已得到充分确立，并已制定了明确的监测策略，但有关非肝硬化门静脉纤维化/特发性门静脉高压 (NCPF/IPH) 中 HCC 的数据
portal_hypertension.abstract: Vascular liver diseases are recognized risk factors for the development of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) in non-cirrhotic livers. While the association is well established in conditions like Budd-Chiari syndrome, which have defined surveillance strategies, data regarding HCC in non-cirrhotic portal fibrosis/idiopathic portal hypertension (NCPF/IPH) remain limited. We report a case of incidentally detected HCC in a 52-year-old woman with NCPF/IPH and preserved liver function. She initially presented with portal hypertension without hepatic decompensation and was diagnosed with NCPF/IPH based on histology and clinical criteria. portal_hypertension.title: Hemorrhagic shock revealing a spontaneous rupture of a splenic artery aneurysm in a young patient without prior medical history: A rare case and literature review.
portal_hypertension.authors: Benramdane H, Errahal H, Boubacar A
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于病例研究。核心观点：它通常发生在具有已知危险因素（例如妊娠或门静脉高压）的患者中。 临床提示：脾动脉瘤（SAA）是一种罕见疾病，其自发破裂可危及生命。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Splenic artery aneurysm (SAA) is a rare condition, and its spontaneous rupture is life-threatening. It usually occurs in patients with known risk factors such as pregnancy or portal hypertension. We report the case of a 29-year-old male with no prior medical history who presented with sudden abdominal pain and hemorrhagic shock. Contrast-enhanced CT angiography revealed massive hemoperitoneum due to spontaneous rupture of a splenic artery aneurysm. Despite emergency surgical management, the patient died. This case is important because it demonstrates that splenic artery aneurysm rupture can occur in young patients without classic risk factors, highlighting the need to consider this diagnosis...

portal_hypertension.title: Interventional Endoscopic Ultrasound.
portal_hypertension.authors: Diehl DL, Binmoeller KF, Hasan N
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：超声内镜 (EUS) 已从一种用于肿瘤分期和诊断组织采集的诊断方法发展成为一种彻底改变整个疾病谱的微创内窥镜护理的技术。 临床提示：近年来，所执行的手术的数量和类型以及旨在提供 EUS 引导干预的设备都在快速发展。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) has evolved from a diagnostic method for staging tumors and diagnostic tissue acquisition to a technology that has revolutionized minimally invasive endoscopic care across the disease spectrum. Recent years have witnessed a rapid advance in the number and types of procedures that are performed and in the devices that are designed to deliver EUS-guided interventions. These advances offer safer, less-invasive alternatives to traditional therapies and define disruptive technologies that are impacting patient care.
